title: Identifying Practical Challenges in the Implementation of Technical Measures for Data Privacy Compliance
reasoning: The paper identifies challenges related to the concept of privacy itself, explicitly stating in C4.5 'What is Privacy?' that 'Privacy can be interpreted from a theoretical, personal, or even philosophical standpoint'. This discussion of the fundamental understanding and definition of privacy, an inherently ethical concept, is presented as a challenge in implementing technical measures, thus forming a component of evaluating aspects related to ethics and philosophy.
